pencereler.0-5: An airliner dove into the sea off Indonesia. It broke apart at high speed,
pencereler.5-12: and all one hundred two aboard were killed. A navigation unit had been faulty for weeks. In flight, both
pencereler.12-20: pilots worked on it. The autopilot disengaged. The jet slowly rolled and nobody noticed. When they did, it was in a steep
pencereler.20-30: spiral dive. Indonesia tightened maintenance oversight and training.

segmentler.metin: Adam Air Flight 574 dove into the sea off Sulawesi.
It took only both pilots absorbed in troubleshooting a navigation unit.
So how could both pilots absorbed in troubleshooting a navigation unit do this?
The answer is autopilot disengagement while the crew was distracted, leading to an unrecovered spiral dive — and it is why Indonesia tightened maintenance oversight and crew training.
